cases.name: Kristen A. Bradbury Carey
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She spent most of her life in and around the Oxford/Charlton/Southbridge area, and she made friends everywhere she went. Kristen owned her own cleaning company for several years, servicing commercial clients in MA and CT, and recently began working as a full-time custodian for Putnam Elementary School. Kristen was a light in this dark world that should have never burnt out. It is impossible to sum up all that Kristen was, and all that she meant to the people in her life. Her brilliant smile and heart-felt laughter lit up the room. She was a dedicated, loving mother, and her two children were the center of her world. She was not just a daughter or a sister, but the best friend you could ever hope to have by your side. Kristen selflessly cared for her family and friends without hesitation and without obligation. Kristen meant so much to so many people, and she will be deeply, wholly missed."
